verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's core interface is chat-based, and its 'AI Agents', 'Custom Agent Skills', and 'Agent Flows' features let users invoke actions (web scraping, search, custom skills) through natural-language prompts rather than manual UI clicks, and community reviews confirm typical use is via chat commands. However, the evidence never shows concrete examples of natural-language commands controlling app-level operations (e.g., creating workspaces, managing settings) beyond agent/skill invocation. Missing for 10: explicit examples/documentation of NL-driven app control beyond agent skills, independent hands-on confirmation of command-style operation, and detail on command syntax (e.g., @agent).
